data.title: Dj Sensi
data.bio:
Sensi loves music. All shapes and sizing. Collecting favorites and finding new gems to peak the mind and heart but looking for song that may push the moment. Desert grown on home made vhs movies and greatest hits cds the love for sound and creating a vibe to explore the whimsy in the great unknown.
Music, conversations, ideas, and much more in the SENSIVERSE 💖
